headline: GNS FAIL on its coverage clause only. Soundness holds: RGN4 0 false certificates on all 240 noisy main cases (eps 0.01 / 0.02; Exact recount), flips <= m on 240/240, one-sided CP95 upper bound on the case-false rate 0.0124 (<= 0.05). Coverage does not: C(RGN4) at eps 0.02 = 0.066, seed-clustered CI95 [0.051, 0.081], below the pre-registered 0.10 mean / CI lower > 0.05. The noise-blind RG4 certifies more (C 0.235 at eps 0.02) but is false on 24 of 120 eps 0.02 cases (0.20 [0.13, 0.27]) and 16 of 120 at eps 0.01; RGN4_0 (margin 0) is false on the same cases. RGN4_or (margin = true flips) reaches C 0.316 at eps 0.02 with 0 false, so most of the coverage gap is the price of the m rule's worst-case margin, not of noise itself (Inferred).
gate_failure_note: GNS_noise_soundness FAIL: clauses (a) 0 false when flips <= m and (b) CP upper <= 0.05 pass; (c) C_RGN4 eps2 mean >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0.05 fails (0.066 [0.051, 0.081]). GN0_control FAIL as pre-registered (#97 item 3, Inferred FAIL before the run): RGN4_0 differs from RG4 on one eps0 case, main/cycle3/8410024/0.0, in 2 slots (steps 6 and 8, both inside the burn-in, where RG4 passes SP8 certificates through); 0 differing slots after the burn-in; RGN4 zero false on eps0 (clause passes).
